headline.zh: 用自然语言生成广告创意
headline.en: Generate ad creatives with plain language

scenario.zh: 你描述产品和目标受众，Melius 生成广告文案和视觉方案
scenario.en: You describe your product and audience; Melius generates ad copy and visual concepts

instruction.zh: 选择一个产品类型开始
instruction.en: Choose a product type to start

output.zh: 为能量饮料生成创意方向
output.en: Generate creative directions for energy drink

input.zh: 有机绿茶能量饮料，含天然咖啡因和维生素B，目标客户是25-35岁注重健康的职场人士
input.en: Organic green tea energy drink with natural caffeine and vitamin B, targeting health-conscious professionals aged 25-35

output.zh: 展示早晨办公场景，重点是清新提神而非过度刺激；配色使用柔和绿色和白色；文案强调天然成分和持久能量
output.en: Show morning office setting, emphasizing gentle alertness over overstimulation; use soft green and white palette; messaging highlights natural ingredients and sustained energy

output.zh: 为语言学习应用生成创意
output.en: Generate creatives for language learning app

input.zh: AI对话式语言学习应用，通过真实场景对话练习，适合想快速掌握日常交流的成年学习者
input.en: AI conversational language learning app using real-world scenarios, for adults who want practical communication skills

output.zh: 展示用户在旅行、餐厅等场景使用应用；视觉突出手机界面中的对话气泡；文案聚焦实用会话和即时反馈
output.en: Show users in travel, restaurant scenarios using the app; visuals highlight conversation bubbles in phone interface; copy focuses on practical dialogue and instant feedback

instruction.zh: 为你的创意选择呈现方式
instruction.en: Pick the format for your creative

output.zh: 生成静态图片广告文案和构图
output.en: Generate static image ad copy and layout

output.zh: 主标题：自然能量，清醒一整天 | 副标题：有机绿茶提取 | 构图：产品瓶居中，背景是晨光中的绿叶
output.en: Headline: Natural energy, all day clarity | Subhead: Organic green tea extract | Layout: Product bottle centered, morning light through green leaves background

output.zh: 三个场景展示每日能量转变
output.en: Three scenes showing daily energy transformation

detail.zh: 早晨疲惫状态，特写困倦表情
detail.en: Morning fatigue, close-up of tired expression

detail.zh: 打开饮料，自然光透过绿色液体
detail.en: Open drink, natural light through green liquid

detail.zh: 充满活力工作，笑容和专注表情
detail.en: Energized work, smiling and focused expression

takeaway.zh: 示例展示了如何用产品描述生成广告创意方向和格式化方案；实际视觉资产需在 Melius 平台制作
takeaway.en: Examples show how product descriptions generate creative directions and formatted proposals; actual visual assets are created on the Melius platform
